# Next.js Frontend Rules
- Next.js 16.0.7 with App Router, React 19.0.1
- Ant Design 5.25.1, Redux Toolkit 2.6.1
- Routes: src/app/, Modules: presentation/ui/modules/ (16)
- API clients: infrastructure/api/ (55+)
## Module Codes
- cmn001000: Customer, cmn002000: Category
- cmn005000: User/permission, cmn007000: Schedule
- cmn015000: Workflow designer, ctm001000: Page builder
- sfa001000-006000: Sales force modules
